desc: A shot of an office full of trash.
Kevin, sitting at his desk, throws trash on the floor beside him, where other trash already lies.
Kevin and Pam stand with a spinning wheel turning between them, as people clap.
Kevin spins around in circles at his desk, seen through the blinds.
Stanley and Erin sit at the cafeteria table, Stanley taps her hand and slides the sandwich toward himself.
Meredith and Pam stand with a shiny spinning wheel turning between them, as people clap.
Meredith and Pam stand with a shiny spinning wheel turning between them, as Pam moves the tiny wheel in front of everyone.
A shot of a rat moving along the floor among the trash in a cluttered office.
A little girl spins around in the yard in front of the house, as Jim leaves it with a present in his hand.
Jim is putting his bag in the trunk of a silver car, when Pam runs out of the house with a banana in her hand.
A young man in glasses leans over the reception desk, holding a magazine, where Erin sits talking to another young man.
A young man leans over the reception desk, holding a Newsweek magazine with a brain-map illustration of a head on the cover.
A young man in glasses winks, while leaning over the reception desk.
A wide shot of guests at an outdoor party, with Phyllis in the back sipping an orange drink next to a man.
A shot of Darryl smiling at the outdoor party, as a woman with dreadlocks adjusts his tie.
Jim and Pam walking in the street with concerned expressions, Jim holding a wrapped present and Pam eating a banana.
A man with a tray of drinks approaches Jim and Pam, and Pam takes a drink from his tray, handing him the banana peel.
Dwight, sitting at his desk, takes a piece of paper, crumples it in his hands, and throws it behind.
A man is giving a toast with a glass of champagne, as the bride smiles beside people around tables with flowers in the garden.
A man in a suit sits down at the piano in the garden, a glass of champagne resting on it.
Oscar sits in the office kitchen, reading a newspaper and choking on his drink, as Pam and Jim stand nearby.
A woman in the office canteen pulls out a cleaver and holds it up in front of Dwight's eyes.
Andy takes his card out of his wallet and hands it to a young man in glasses.
Seen through a half-open door, Jim leans against the stair railing, resting his forehead on his hand.
Dwight grabs the woman's hand and lifts it repeatedly, letting it drop onto the cutting board.
Dwight repeatedly raises a cleaver above his head, preparing to bring it down on the woman's hand, while she drinks from a can.
Dwight swings his arms left and right, stretching, while a redheaded woman watches, in the office cafeteria.
Dwight makes circles with a cleaver in his hand above the cutting board, where the woman holds her hand.
Dwight stretches his interlocked hands out in front of the break room vending machines, stern and determined.
Darryl walks into the canteen finds Dwight holding a cleaver over a woman's hand on the cutting board, and walks out unfazed.
Darryl walks into the canteen and places his laptop on the table, opening it, while Dwight stands with a cleaver.
Andy, Erin, and a young man with a worried expression stand in a hallway by the door as he knocks.
The young man in glasses rests his head against the door frame, looking disappointed, as another man stands in front of  the door.
A wide shot of a restaurant seen at night through its front windows, with a neon sign glowing as people sit inside.
Dwight and a redhead woman sit across from each other in the office canteen at night, both making disgusted faces while looking at a laptop.
